scope: Read-only API-level recent-history metadata scan; not end-to-end GUI save timing
limitations: Single measurements with warm/unspecified OS and SMB cache state
Public Win32 API sequence emulates the relevant Boost 1.84.0 implementation; not an instrumented application build
